text.tspan: Female labor force participation rate: 1980 vs. 2024
Share of the female working-age population who are economically active (employed or unemployed). Figures
refer to national estimates and may not be fully comparable across countries.

tspan.tspan: Labour Force Statistics, via World Bank (2026)
Employment is defined in line with the 13th ICLS and includes the production of goods for own use, such as subsistence farming. Where

text.tspan: data is unavailable, the closest value within 5 years is shown instead.
